messages.subject: Energy & Infrastructure Executive | ESG, External Affairs & Strategic Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Max,

Your executive-search work across energy, infrastructure, investment and growth platforms is closely aligned with my background. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with responsibility across government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates where infrastructure and energy growth depend on institutional trust, regulatory discipline and responsible execution. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, with broader international mobility.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
